tuning_offset_applied.note: This constant offset was applied after the optional affine correction by viewer_tuner_topview.html.

tuning_affine_applied.note: Use identity coefficients a0=0,a1=1,a2=0,b0=0,b1=0,b2=1 for no affine X/Z correction.

target_hold_accuracy.note: Computed in viewer from the current adjusted positions. Reported hold_avg_percent is the average of the highest 5 overlap frames inside the best stable target placement held for at least 1 second(s).
